interpretive_boundaries: The figure is an author synthesis of stable repository contracts and local engineering tests; it reports no accuracy, latency, cost, user outcome, reviewer benefit or production result.
A typed role, hash, locator, citation or verification record supports traceability and controlled decision-making; none guarantees source truth or completeness.
The independent verifier writes a status and rationale but cannot silently rewrite the claim or evidence; the deterministic composer cannot promote an exception into the supported narrative.
Named approval supplies authority over the current report version and persisted content hash, not new factual evidence. Editing changes the version/hash, clears approval and requires re-review.
Retry and idempotency are path-specific and bounded. The base fixed workflow has explicit termination and does not imply globally idempotent or distributed production execution.
Human-review quality, usability, time and benefit remain unrun; live-company, external-model, autonomous-publication and hosted-production claims are excluded.
Actively changing company-research implementation and test files are deliberately excluded from this stable fixed-portfolio-workflow exhibit seal.
